lines.text: Many learners say: I go to school by walk.
Better: I go to school on foot.
On foot! He goes to work on foot.

data.wrong: I go to school by walk.
data.right: I go to school on foot.

native.tip: हिंदी के “पैदल” का अंग्रेज़ी रूप “on foot” है, “by walk” नहीं।
native.caption: क्या आप भी कहते हैं “I go to school by walk”? 😅 अंग्रेज़ी में “I go to school on foot” सही है, क्योंकि पैदल जाने के लिए “on foot” कहा जाता है। Ama की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “on foot”। “by walk” की जगह “on foot” बोलें। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: The English for Hindi “paidal” is “on foot”, not “by walk”.
en.caption: Do you say “I go to school by walk”? 😅 In English “I go to school on foot” is right, because walking from place to place is said “on foot”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
